name: DedicatedServer
author: EndlessSkys
description:
Allows users to connect to Dedicated Servers through the in-game join menu. By adding a join IP address or similar, a user can join a server. Self hosting will be availible soon.
It is recommended that you use as few other mods as possible, errors may occur with them on. 
To find servers, check the Server List for any active ones! 

The Public Server website can be found at http://vivo-holidays.tun.ply.gg:25463/s/first-international-stellardrive-hub as of now.
